# Redpanda

> Redpanda is the trust layer for the agentic enterprise. The Redpanda Agentic Data Plane (ADP) lets organizations build, operate, and govern AI agents with secure access to enterprise data, a unified AI gateway, full audit trails, and centralized MCP server governance. Redpanda also provides a high-performance, Kafka-compatible streaming data platform built in C++ that powers real-time applications, AI workloads, and analytics with predictable low-latency performance.

Redpanda is a $1B+ venture-backed company trusted in production by the New York Stock Exchange, Jump Trading, Alpaca, Akamai, ShareChat, Chess.com, and hundreds of enterprises across finance, gaming, AI, social platforms, and cybersecurity. The platform combines blazing-fast data streaming with enterprise AI agent infrastructure, offering Serverless, BYOC, and self-managed deployment options.

## Core Streaming Platform

- [Redpanda Homepage](https://www.redpanda.com): Platform overview and getting started
- [What is Redpanda?](https://www.redpanda.com/what-is-redpanda): Conceptual overview of the platform architecture
- [Redpanda Streaming](https://www.redpanda.com/data-streaming): Kafka-compatible streaming engine, deployment options, and capabilities
- [Redpanda Connect](https://www.redpanda.com/connect): 300+ connectors with composable YAML configs, native CDC, and AI connectors with GPU support
- [Redpanda Serverless](https://www.redpanda.com/data-streaming/serverless): Auto-scaling serverless streaming with zero infrastructure management
- [Redpanda BYOC](https://www.redpanda.com/data-streaming/bring-your-own-cloud-byoc): Deploy in your own cloud with managed operations and enterprise security
- [Redpanda Console (Kafka UI)](https://www.redpanda.com/data-streaming/redpanda-console-kafka-ui): Web UI for managing streaming infrastructure
- [Platform Capabilities](https://www.redpanda.com/data-streaming/platform-capabilities): Tiered storage, data transforms, observability, and Iceberg-native engine
- [Pricing Estimator](https://www.redpanda.com/data-streaming/price-estimator): Estimate deployment costs
